status_definition: Numbers supplied by the owner in a written brief. No job artifact (job ID, job JSON, shot count, calibration record, or settings) is attached. NOT [measured]. May not be cited outside this directory in a [measured] form.
promotion_rule: status becomes MEASURED only when: (1) the job IDs for both blocks are attached, (2) the job JSON for each is committed or hashed here, (3) shot counts and the four CHSH measurement settings are read out of the job JSON rather than remembered, and (4) the backend calibration record covering the run window is captured. Until all four, the tag stays OWNER-REPORTED.
promotion_blocked_by: no calibration timestamp or calibration record
reported_by: owner, relayed to the theoretical physicist by the team lead
recorded_at_utc_is: date the record was written, NOT the run date -- the run date is unknown

device.backend_claim_basis: owner report; not verified against the backend properties API
device.device_class: fixed-frequency transmon, heavy-hex lattice (vendor-published, not re-verified here)
device.calibration_timestamp_note: NOT SUPPLIED. The run is only reportable with a calibration timestamp -- see docs/qpu/nitrogenase_prereg_TEMPLATE.json device block. This is the single largest provenance gap.
device.calibration_reused_basis: owner's recalibration control: IBM did not recalibrate during a 20-minute wait, so block 2 ran on block 1's calibration

result_001_chsh.claim: measured CHSH value S = 2.61 +/- 0.02 on ibm_fez qubits 44 and 45, 2 qubits
result_001_chsh.S_uncertainty_definition: NOT SUPPLIED. Unknown whether statistical-only, or including systematic. Treated as statistical-only in the analysis, which makes every stated sigma an upper bound on significance.
result_001_chsh.state_fidelity_metric_note: owner said '~98% faithful to design'; the metric (state fidelity / process fidelity / 1-trace-distance) was not stated. All fidelity arithmetic in RESULTS.md is conditional on a Werner-equivalent reading.
result_001_chsh.settings_note: The four CHSH settings (a0,a1,b0,b1) were not supplied. Our artifact stores the CHSH VALUE, not the angles -- the LP-optimal angles are recomputed from the state by chimax_settings() in docs/artifacts/quantum_likeness/likeness_probes.py and are NOT persisted. So we cannot currently verify that the hardware run used the pre-registered settings, which is the one thing E2 exists to test.
result_001_chsh.qpu_seconds_overrun_reason: a shot setting failed and the circuits ran at full shots
result_001_chsh.pre_registered_success_leg1_met: MARGINAL -- 2.61 clears 2.60 by 0.01, i.e. 0.5 sigma at the stated error
result_001_chsh.pre_registered_success_leg2_met: UNEVALUABLE -- S_model needs E1's measured channel; E1 never ran
result_001_chsh.pre_registered_verdict: not a pre-registered success; leg 1 marginal, leg 2 unevaluable

result_002_autonomous_drift.claim: with no intervening recalibration over a 20-minute wait, qubit frequency deviation moved 1.85 kHz -> 1.50 kHz; the drift is autonomous, not recalibration-induced
result_002_autonomous_drift.quantity: qubit frequency deviation from its calibrated value, magnitude, kHz
result_002_autonomous_drift.reading_note: READING ASSUMED, FLAG FOR CONFIRMATION: treated as |f_q(t) - f_q(calibration)| in kHz. The alternative reading -- a drift RATE in kHz per unspecified time unit -- is not analysed, because a rate without a denominator is not a quantity. If the owner meant something else, R2 must be re-stated before it is cited.
result_002_autonomous_drift.control_performed: yes -- this is the experiment's value: it removes 'the backend was recalibrated between the runs' as an explanation for any between-run disagreement
result_002_autonomous_drift.sign_note: Only magnitudes were reported. Without signs, two points cannot distinguish drifting toward the calibrated value from drifting through it, so the drift rate is reported as a BRACKET [0.29, 2.79] Hz/s, not a number.
result_002_autonomous_drift.qpu_seconds_allocated_note: 55 s total reported minus 39 s CHSH; derived, not reported

result_003_nitrogenase_chemistry.detail: The nitrogen chemistry check returned no clear result and is still owed. Recorded here so the gap is visible rather than absent. No number, no claim, nothing to cite.
result_003_nitrogenase_chemistry.framing_reminder: Per docs/QPU_NITROGENASE_EXPERIMENTS.md and the prereg template: hardware calibrates or validates our simulator; hardware never computes the chemistry. No sentence of the form 'the QPU produced X kJ/mol' is permitted regardless of how this turns out.

spend.governance_note: The 30 s cap did not hold: it is enforced by ESTIMATE at submission, not by the runtime. A failed shot setting silently escalated the job to full shots and the job was allowed to finish. Any future cap must be enforced by the shot count in the PUB list, which is knowable before submission, and not by a seconds estimate.

tags_used_in_this_directory.[reported]: supplied by the owner; no artifact
tags_used_in_this_directory.[measured]: reserved -- nothing in this directory may use it yet
tags_used_in_this_directory.[analytic]: closed-form arithmetic from reported inputs; re-runnable via analysis.py
tags_used_in_this_directory.[interpretation]: a reading of the numbers, not itself a measurement
tags_used_in_this_directory.[speculation]: a hypothesis with a stated test that could refute it
tags_used_in_this_directory.[design]: a proposed experiment amendment, not yet pre-registered

what_this_directory_does_not_contain: any topological protection or anyon claim
any device coherence (T1/T2) number -- E1 was not run
